name: Abell 2495 (Hubble)
blurb: Abell 2495, a galaxy cluster, seen by Hubble.
label: abell2495-hubble
story: Hubble looked into the galaxy cluster Abell 2495 at the spot where a Type Ia supernova had flared and faded, searching for whatever faint home its exploding star might have had.

claims.text: The program (12937) takes deep Hubble imaging at the locations of apparently hostless Type Ia supernovae in rich galaxy clusters, after the supernovae faded
The target position is that of the Type Ia supernova Abell2495_5_13_0 in Abell 2495
The study searched for faint hosts at these supernova locations
